title: Divergence: render_frame caps at L0 + forge build run fails E0382 (#90 interrupted editor)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_editor_render_frame.rs::divergence_render_frame_certifies_l3 (render_frame L0, not L3 — u64_to_string ens has no upper length bound so the bounded concat §4.2 CAP precondition is undischargeable) and ::divergence_editor_build_run_compiles (rustc E0382: render_frame(b) moves Buffer b, reused next loop iteration). decode IS L3 with teeth (the done half). Authority: thermite-design.md §4.2 + .design/basis/07-strings.md REQ-4/REQ-8 + the #90 thesis. Tests #[ignore]'d (blocker #90); they PASS-as-fail under --include-ignored against the uncommitted state.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: RESOLVED by 4277bf1 (#90): render_frame caps at L3 (the u64_to_string len<=20 upper-bound ens discharges the §4.2 concat CAP) and the build E0382 (render_frame -> &Buffer) is fixed. The 2 pinned divergence tests were folded into editor_runs.rs (which now asserts render_frame/decode L3 + the build+run). forge check: render_frame L3, decode L3; forge build --entry run compiles + runs (mid-text splice). Critic-confirmed NO DIVERGENCE.
